notes: The v6 driver and matching helper passed independent ELF and embedded-code inspection before import.
Embedded AIDL Effect V4/common V5 and legacy AELI share one driver; control protocol remains 3.
Android factory compatibility, SELinux behavior and real audio processing remain unverified for this build.

Soundstage now uses a 250 Hz side shelf and 20 ms target ramps; UI 30/50/60/75 selects upper-band side gain 0.6/1.0/1.4/2.0, preserving centre and mono sum. This widens existing stereo, not mono synthesis or HRTF distance rendering.
Width/enable/disable transitions settle to exact dry at neutral/off; both DSP controller paths continue the fade after disable. Repeated preference writes do not restart the ramp.

Strict, fast-math, ASan/UBSan, combined-chain and Soong host tests passed, including live EffectDSPMain parameters 137/1204 and controller fade-to-dry. The isolated kernel Binder test was skipped (77) because its dedicated host environment was unavailable.

Native post-gain support remains -30..+30 dB. The signed APK, its current UI, other effects, scheduler and transport are unchanged. New-build Android listening remains pending; wider sides can use more headroom with the existing limiter.
